title: Understanding the Pattern
text: The pattern \D*:\w+(,\w+)+ is designed to match strings that start with non-digit characters, followed by a colon, and then a sequence of words separated by commas.

title: Analyzing the Match All Cases
text:
Let's break down the 'Match all of these below' cases:
$$1$$. "total cats petted: 60,102,305"
$$2$$. "my cats' names are: amy,baron,carol"
$$3$$. "the current time is 20:59"

Consider whether the pattern \D*:\w+(,\w+)+ can match all these cases.

title: Analyzing the Pattern
text: The pattern \D*:\w+(,\w+)+ expects a sequence of words separated by commas after a colon. It does not account for numbers or other characters like colons within the sequence.
